summary: Iteration 82 - Enterprise Workspaces Sidebar & Page Testing Complete. All 13 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests verified sidebar restructuring, Enterprise Workspaces page, workspace CRUD, member management, and delete confirmation flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Superadmin sidebar correctly shows Enterprise section with Workspaces, Team & Access, Discord App Setup links
Superadmin sidebar correctly hides Platform Admin, Analytics, API Key Usage, and Workspace Settings sections
Non-superadmin sidebar correctly shows Workspace Settings section with General, Members, Billing, Discord Apps links
Non-superadmin sidebar correctly hides Enterprise section
Enterprise Workspaces page (data-testid='enterprise-workspaces-page') loads correctly with workspace cards
Workspace cards show name, slug, plan badge (5 orgs · unlimited bots), org count, member count
Workspace card expansion shows Members with role badges (OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER) and edit/remove buttons
Workspace card expansion shows Organisations list and Plan section with org limit (X/5) and unlimited bots
New Workspace button (data-testid='toggle-create-ws') toggles inline create form correctly
Workspace creation works - new workspace appears in list with success toast
Workspace deletion works - confirmation form requires exact name match, workspace removed with success toast
Cascade protection works - cannot delete workspace with organisations (returns 400)
Member role editing - clicking edit icon shows admin/member toggle buttons
Member removal - trash icon visible for non-owner members

features_tested.details: Enterprise section with Workspaces, Team & Access, Discord App Setup links visible for superadmin
Platform Admin, Analytics, API Key Usage, Workspace Settings NOT shown for superadmin
Workspace Settings section with General, Members, Billing, Discord Apps links visible for workspace owner
Enterprise section NOT shown for non-superadmin users
Page loads with data-testid='enterprise-workspaces-page', shows workspace cards with name, slug, plan badge, counts
Clicking card shows Members (with role badges, edit/remove buttons), Organisations list, Plan section (X/5 orgs, unlimited bots)
Toggle button shows inline form, entering name and clicking Create creates workspace with success toast
Delete Workspace button shows confirmation form requiring exact name match, deletion works with success toast
Cannot delete workspace with organisations - returns 400 with clear error message
Clicking edit icon on member opens admin/member toggle buttons for role change
Trash icon visible for non-owner members, clicking removes member from workspace
GET /api/v2/workspaces returns workspaces with org_count and member_count
POST/DELETE /api/v2/workspaces works correctly with proper validation
